capabilities: Publish notes as blog posts or drafts
Update existing posts through frontmatter tracking
Upload embedded images, PDFs, audio and video
Publish to multiple configured Pagecord blogs
Read title, slug, tags and other metadata from frontmatter
extras: Video uploads (MP4, MOV) require a paid Pagecord plan. Deleting a connection removes it from Obsidian settings only, not the blog. A per-connection baseUrl can point at another Pagecord API host for local development.
problem: Moving a note from Obsidian to a Pagecord blog otherwise means copying the text and re-uploading its images and files by hand.

relations.evidence: Publish notes from Obsidian to your Pagecord blog.

summary: Publishes Obsidian notes to a Pagecord blog as posts or drafts, uploading embedded media and tracking posts so later publishes update them.
